messages:
Sam (PM): Heads-up  three enterprise asks landed in sales: strict EU residency, APAC latency guardrails, and a clean migration path for current tenants. Need a concise plan to show execs.
Leah (Sales): Customer highlights: BankX wants no-egress from eu-west. MarketY in APAC needs 95th <=50ms. RetailZ wants staged opt-in with rollback guarantees.
Priya (Arch): Options: (1) policy-driven affinity (fast, lower isolation), (2) reserved lanes (slow, true isolation). Recommend policy-first pilot to buy time for reservation design.
Rafi (Eng): Mechanics: add two policy attributes: region_preference and isolation_level. Sample: ```route_policy { tenant: "bankx" region_preference: "eu-west-1" isolation_level: "soft" }``` Soft = affinity; hard = reservation + admission control.
Kai (SRE): Ops notes: hard reservations reduce placement flexibility. Need evacuation playbook, region-failure rollback, and alarm for reservation saturation. Also require a chaos drill before GA.
Marta (Compliance): If we claim "no-egress", we must validate KMS key residency, logging retention in-region, and a compliance attestation checklist. Pilot language should not promise absolute no-egress.
Sam (PM): Proposed short roadmap: Phase A (6 weeks) = policy DSL + templates + simulator + telemetry + two pilots (EU and APAC). Phase B (Q3) = reservation lanes, admission controller, migration dry-run tool, pricing appendix.
Leah (Sales): We'll market Phase A as "Residency Preview". No hard contract language until Phase B. I'll coordinate pilot customers and pricing knobs.
Priya (Arch): Telemetry gating: percent_requests_served_from_preferred_region >= 90% for pilot tenants, fallback_count per tenant <= 1% over canary window, and cache_cross_region_miss delta < 10%.
Rafi (Eng): Implementation plan: sprint 1 spike for simulator + policy proto, sprint 2 route-eval + dry-run endpoint, sprint 3 metrics + pilot support. Need two engs and 0.25 PM FTE.
Kai (SRE): Ops acceptance for Phase A canary: 48h ramp with step increases, <3 P0s, automated rollback on rising error rate or >25% cross-region latency degradation. Also schedule a runbook tabletop.
Marta (Compliance): Add to launch checklist: KMS region proof, audit log retention config, and privacy team sign-off for any tenant claiming residency.
Sam (PM): Action items: Rafi  prototype policy proto + dry-run API (1 week). Priya  template catalog + telemetry spec (5 days). Kai  ops runbook + chaos plan (10 days). Leah  pilot signups + non-binding pilot terms (4 days). Marta  compliance checklist (3 days). I'll draft the customer-facing one-pager.
roadmap-bot: Reminder: link the roadmap PR in #release-war-room before COB Fri. :calendar:
Leah (Sales): Ack, will put draft pilot terms in the PR.
Rafi (Eng): Posting a short design note and simulator assumptions later today.
Priya (Arch): Also we should consider a policy catalog with three presets: economy-global, latency-first (APAC), residency-first (EU) for easy sales conversations.
Sam (PM): OK. We'll reconvene in 1 week to review spikes and lock quarter-level commitments. Thanks all.
